decisions.reason: The item explicitly defines a predicate for a continuously Frechet differentiable map on an open U; it neither asserts that every such map is a nonlinear forward model in the narrower supplier terminology nor invokes a theorem requiring U to be nonempty. If U is empty, V is empty, the derivative family is the unique empty map into the bounded operators and is continuous, and the inequality quantified over V x V is vacuously true. If a pair in V is used, its points already witness nonemptiness of U. Thus allowing the empty case produces no undefined derivative evaluation, existence claim, or invalid supplier application. The displayed ordered-pair inequality agrees with Clason (11.23); the item expressly assumes it separately from the one-basepoint cone condition.
